task_completion.description: The Yoast SEO plugin is activated in the WordPress dashboard.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The WordPress 'Plugins' page shows 'Yoast SEO' as active (indicated by a blue highlight or a 'Deactivate' link), or the 'SEO' menu item appears in the sidebar.

task_completion.description: The site-wide Title Separator is set to a dash (-).
task_completion.visual_evidence: In Yoast SEO settings (Settings > Site representation or Search Appearance), the dash '-' icon is selected/highlighted among the separator options.

task_completion.description: The Homepage Meta description is set correctly.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Yoast SEO settings for the Homepage show the text: 'Explore expert articles on WordPress development, blogging tips, and essential plugins for building better websites.'

task_completion.description: The post 'Getting Started with WordPress' has the correct focus keyphrase and meta description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The editor for 'Getting Started with WordPress' shows the Focus keyphrase as 'getting started with wordpress' and the Meta description as 'Learn why WordPress powers over 40% of the web. This beginner guide covers the key advantages of WordPress and how to start building your first site.'

task_completion.description: The post '10 Essential WordPress Plugins Every Site Needs' has the correct focus keyphrase and meta description.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The editor for '10 Essential WordPress Plugins Every Site Needs' shows the Focus keyphrase as 'essential wordpress plugins' and the Meta description as 'Discover the top 10 must-have WordPress plugins for 2024 including Yoast SEO, WP Super Cache, Wordfence, and WooCommerce to supercharge your website.'

integrity.description: The agent used the WordPress web interface rather than just executing CLI commands.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the browser navigating through the WordPress dashboard, clicking menus, and typing into text fields.

integrity.description: The agent did not skip the configuration by simply viewing existing settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the agent actively typing or pasting the specific meta descriptions into the Yoast SEO meta boxes.

integrity.description: The agent did not use the terminal to modify the database directly via WP-CLI for the SEO fields.
integrity.visual_evidence: The terminal is either not used or only used for initial navigation, while the primary work happens in the browser.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The internal identifier for the dash separator in Yoast is 'sc-dash'. The homepage meta description must contain 'explore expert articles', 'development', 'blogging tips', and 'essential plugins'. For the first post, the meta description must mention '40%', 'beginner', and 'advantages'. For the second post, the focus keyphrase is 'essential wordpress plugins' and the description must list 'Yoast SEO, WP Super Cache, Wordfence, and WooCommerce'.
